This loop will work while bottom is still under the top and while current bottom and top symbols of the array are the same.

If both conditions are true, we decrement top
When the loop is over, we land at this statement. Here we have to check which of the loop condition became false (i.e., returned 0)
If we breaked out of the loop because bottom ven over the top - bottom >= top - then all pairwise comparison succeeded and the string is a palindrom - return 1
Otherwise we only could breaked out of the loop s[bottom] != s[top] - then he string is not a palindrom - return 0
